Input images: Image 1 is appearance-only guidance for broad visible adult facial and hair traits; the generated subject remains an original fictional adult.

Create a photorealistic editorial scene at a bright Raypunk solar-weather relay station suspended above a crimson salt desert. One unmistakably adult woman is the station mechanic, wearing an ivory flight coverall with turquoise piping and a translucent protective collar. Her appearance follows the attached portrait only as a visual reference: long, center-parted, softly wavy near-black hair, warm brown almond-shaped eyes, an oval face, softly arched brows, and natural full lips. She slides a triangular crystal key into the exposed photon semaphore while her other hand steadies a brass-edged glass lens; the machine's rotating prisms visibly reconnect three saturated light lanes across the sky to an arriving bubble-window mail rocket. Surround her with polished chrome consoles, rounded pastel enamel housings, sweeping tail fins, vacuum tubes, analog star-chart dials, atomic sunburst signage, and luminous glass conduits. Keep materials tactile, tool contact unambiguous, anatomy natural, and the scene believable as a staged location photograph. A medium-long knee-up frame keeps her face, both hands, and the entire semaphore connection large enough to inspect while the elevated station and approaching rocket remain readable behind her. Ray-born backlight draws a crisp rim around her hair and translucent collar, while soft frontal fill preserves natural skin, crystal facets, and precise hand contact.

Avoid: fake-looking background, body distortion, low resolution, broken window geometry, over-processed retouching, illustration look, distorted fingers, 3D render look, broken facial features
